questions.q: How many variations of the for loop does Apex support?
options: One -- only the traditional for loop
Two -- traditional and list iteration
Three -- traditional, list/set iteration, and the SOQL for loop
Four, including a reverse for loop
questions.explain: Apex's for loop has three variations: the traditional for loop, the list or set iteration for loop, and the SOQL for loop that iterates directly over query results.

questions.q: What is the key difference between a while loop and a do-while loop?
options: There is no difference -- they are aliases for the same syntax
while checks its condition before running the body; do-while runs the body once before checking the condition
do-while can only run a fixed number of times
while loops can't use break or continue, but do-while loops can
questions.explain: A do-while loop is written as a block followed by while (condition);, meaning the body executes first and the condition is checked afterward, so the body always runs at least once.

questions.q: In the list or set iteration for loop, for (variable : list_or_set), what type must the loop variable be?
options: Always a String, regardless of the collection's type
The same primitive or sObject type as the list or set being iterated
It must be declared as Object
It is inferred as a List automatically
questions.explain: In the list or set iteration for loop, the loop variable must be of the same primitive or sObject type as the list_or_set being iterated.

questions.q: What does the continue statement do inside a loop?
options: Exits the entire loop immediately
Restarts the loop from its first iteration
Skips to the next iteration of the loop
Pauses the loop until a condition changes
questions.explain: Both continue and break are loop control statements; continue skips to the next iteration of the loop, while break exits the entire loop.

questions.q: Which loop form is unique to Apex (not found in a language like plain Java) because it iterates directly over query results?
options: The traditional for loop
The while loop
The SOQL for loop: for (variable : [soql_query])
The do-while loop
questions.explain: The SOQL for loop, written as for (variable : [soql_query]) or for (variable_list : [soql_query]), iterates directly over the rows or batches returned by an inline query.
